title: creating a Page asks one question, its kind

criteria.text: Creating a Page asks one question, its kind: each kind is a question with a one-line purpose, and the screen says this just starts the process
criteria.note: `/create` asks one question, the kind, as four answers that are questions about the thing (sell, gather, offer, Be creative), with 'This just gets things started' [V WhatAreYouStarting.tsx]. Built by #326 (Reviewed by), #360, #364 and #382 (review-skipped). Checked: no `[guards F061.1]` marker anywhere; `WhatAreYouStarting.test.tsx` is unmarked (#575). Shipped: Deploy health green on a5eefa3, 8958e93, c006495, fae5d98. Smoked: no smoke route for /create

criteria.text: Creation lands the owner on their draft Page, where they fill in everything else, the name included
criteria.note: `startDraftAction` creates the draft and `redirect`s to the draft Page, where the name, place, description, tags and photo are filled in on the Page editor [V src/app/create/actions.ts]. Built by #326, #360, #364. Checked: unmarked `src/app/create/actions.test.ts` (#575). Smoked: no route for a fresh draft Page

criteria.text: A Page's map and card placement comes from a single resolver evaluated at read time; nothing precomputed or cached
criteria.note: `resolvePagePlacements` in `src/lib/groups/resolve-page-placement.ts`, used by `resolveShop`; no placement column or cache in the migrations [V grep]. Built by T143 (commit f244852, direct, no PR, so no review, no Deploy health run); #1074 (10-26, review-skipped, green) later changed how a Page reads its place. `resolve-page-placement.test.ts` tests shape, not the absence of stored placement (#576).
